fuel.title: Fuel
fuel.subtitle: Track fuel refills, estimated consumption and prices across your fleet.
fuel.pricesHelp: Set the fuel prices used to estimate GPS report costs. The most recent price applicable to the report date is used.
fuel.defaultPricesHelp: Used when no historical price applies to the report date. These replace the old fixed values.
fuel.historyHelp: A price applies from its effective date. "Until" is optional: left empty, the price stays valid indefinitely.
fuel.gpsHelp: The GPS report estimates consumption from distances calculated using vehicle GPS positions. Click "Generate" to compute the report for a given date.
fuel.gpsEmpty: No GPS report for this date. Generate one using the button above.
fuel.gpsQualityInsufficient: GPS distance too low to be reliable this day (positions exist but movement < 0.1 km).
fuel.costNoPrice: Cost not computed: fuel price not configured for this vehicle.
fuel.gpsQualitySuspicious: This distance looks like GPS noise (vehicle likely stayed put) rather than a real trip — verify before relying on it.
fuel.gpsDiagHelp: Shows what is actually stored in the database for this date, per vehicle: number of fixes, time gaps, suspect positions, and a comparison between raw distance (straight line) vs filtered distance (the one used by the report). No invented figures: if fixes are missing (app closed), the raw distance is also incomplete.
fuel.gpsDiagSparse: Sparse coverage detected (gaps > 60 s between fixes): the app was probably closed or in background during part of the trip. GPS distance therefore undercounts the real distance. Keep the app open (screen on) during trips for an accurate measure.
fuel.gpsDiagNoSpeed: This device never reported speed: the "speed rule" of the noise filter cannot apply, only movements above the noise threshold are counted.
fuel.gpsDiagEmpty: No GPS positions recorded for this date. Make sure the app was open with location enabled during the trips.
fuel.helpManual: • Manual entry: real fuel fill-ups recorded by the team (liters, cost, mileage). Used to track actual fuel expenses.
fuel.helpGps: • GPS Report: automatic estimation based on vehicle GPS positions. Uses the vehicle's theoretical consumption to estimate costs. Complements manual entries.
fuel.kmHelper: Do not enter the odometer reading
fuel.requiredFields: Please fill in vehicle, liters, mileage, cost and date.
fuel.confirmDeleteMessage: Permanently delete this fuel log? This action cannot be undone.
